specs.quote: Each slot in AMS lite is equipped with a feeder responsible for feeding the filament into or out of the tool head. The feeder includes a filament detection sensor
specs.note: The section 'Filament run-out detection and filament backup function' describes run-out handling through the feeder's Hall switch.

specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS lite store page, AMS lite Tech Specs
specs.locator: AMS lite Tech Specs › row 7 (Supported Filament*¹)
specs.quote: PLA, PETG,ASA, PET, PA, PC, PVA (dry), BVOH (dry), PP, POM, HIPS and Bambu PLA-CF
specs.test_condition: Judged from loading / unloading; printer compatibility must also be checked (footnote *¹)
specs.note: The deterministic parse keeps this row as x.supported_filament_1 (the footnote marker '*¹' stops the registry synonym). Cross-check with the wiki filament guide 'AMS / AMS lite Compatibility' column: agrees on PLA, PETG, ASA, PC, PVA/BVOH (dry) and Bambu PLA-CF; the wiki also gives Bambu PA-CF and PAHT-CF as Compatible, ABS and ABS-GF as 'AMS lite: Not Recommended', and its prose says PLA Wood is not recommended for the AMS lite while its table row 'PLA Metal / Wood / Marble' reads Compatible. PP, POM, HIPS, PET and plain PA are not in the wiki table.

value: other brand filament that contains carbon fiber or glass fiber
specs.source_title: Bambu Lab AMS lite store page, AMS lite Tech Specs
specs.locator: AMS lite Tech Specs › row 9 (Unsupported Filament*³)
specs.quote: TPE, TPU, PVA (wet), BVOH (wet), Bambu PET-CF / PA6-CF / TPU 95A and other brand filament that contains carbon fiber or glass fiber
specs.note: Footnote *³: 'Filaments that are too soft, too brittle or too abrasive are not compatible with the AMS lite.' The deterministic parse keeps this row as x.unsupported_filament_3. The wiki filament guide agrees on TPU and PET-CF/GF (Not Compatible) and adds PPA-CF/GF and PPS-CF/GF as Not Compatible (recorded as relations).
